examples.text: Ho trascorso tre anni in prigione.
examples.en: I spent three years in prison.

examples.text: Ho trascorso una settimana in ospedale.
examples.en: I spent a week in the hospital.
Did you have a good summer?
We've spent a lot of time together.

examples.text: Ho trascorso tutta la giornata lì.
examples.en: I spent the whole day there.
